verdict.rationale: Pika's developer platform states that it has no separate test environment and that every generation runs against production at catalog prices. Its playgrounds also run against production with the caller's own key. The keyless catalog and never-charged quote/balance/spend reads are only dry-run-style pricing checks, which is an adjacent capability, not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
